name: QUT Financial Assistance Bursary
summary: A once-off payment for QUT students in sudden financial hardship.
key: $300, $500, $750 or $1,000 depending on need, one per semester.
who: Current domestic or international QUT students enrolled this semester.
need: Bank statements in an accepted format. Screenshots are not accepted.
how: Apply with the online form, or call (07) 3138 2019 to book an appointment.
catches: Single-unit and cross-institutional students are not eligible.
Applications are usually considered after the census date.
